name: Bitter Silver
source:
A Cowboy Bebop-inspired space western visual novel adventure where you get to define your path as bounty hunter Lucia Lopez in the far flung future of the Milky Way Galaxy!

You are Lucia Lopez - a charismatic, down on her luck, ex-solider-turned-bounty-hunter.

Traveling aboard your spaceship, the Athena, you track down bounties to find an answer to a shocking curse that's been plaguing you your whole life. Alongside you is your fun-loving, brash, half human, half partner in crime (and love), Zap Matters, and your team's resident tech expert, a robotic talking cat, Hobbes.

It's up to you, Zap, and Hobbes to journey to a city at the fringes of the Milky Way and track down the last three bounties that stand in your way of finding the answers Lucia has been seeking all her life.

And, uh, make some money along the way to pay for, well, everything else.

Kinda important too.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1906930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部受《星际牛仔》启发的太空西部视觉小说冒险游戏，你将在遥远的银河系未来定义自己作为赏金猎人露西娅·洛佩兹的道路！

你是露西娅·洛佩兹——一位魅力非凡、运气不佳、前士兵出身的赏金猎人。

登上你的宇宙飞船雅典娜号，你追踪赏金，寻找困扰你一生的令人震惊的诅咒的答案。在你身边的是你的爱玩、傲慢、一半人类、一半犯罪（和爱情）伙伴的Zap Matters，以及你团队的常驻技术专家、一只会说话的机器人猫霍布斯。

你、扎普和霍布斯将前往银河系边缘的一座城市，追踪阻碍你找到露西娅一生所寻求答案的最后三项赏金。

而且，呃，一路上赚一些钱来支付其他一切。

也有点重要。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1906930/]Steam[/url]]
